verdict.rationale: Sakana Marlin is itself an autonomous research agent: it forms hypotheses, navigates the web and produces reports on its own. That puts it in the MCP-client role, so serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. Nothing in the evidence shows Marlin running as an MCP server or offering a hosted MCP endpoint that would make this axis apply. The probes also found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface.
